shop.name: Kestrel Roastery
shop.headline: Small-batch roasting, sunlit space, and precision extraction.
shop.tagline: Every cup, architectural zone, and origin lot at Kestrel is structured for clarity—whether you are dropping in for a cortado, exploring the full space with our AI guide, or navigating directly to our Pearl District roastery.

transitNotes: Portland Streetcar NS Line — NW 11th & Couch (2 min walk)
Protected bike racks inside the courtyard gate
Step-free oak threshold and wide aisle clearance

spatialZones.name: 01. Espresso & Brew Bar
spatialZones.description: Anchored by a honed black slate counter and white oak millwork, the front bar pairs side-by-side espresso extraction with hand-poured single-origin filters.

spatialZones.name: 02. Solid Oak Tasting Table
spatialZones.signatureEquipment: 14ft Oregon White Oak Slab with Recessed Power
spatialZones.description: Centered beneath timber rafters and skylights, our communal table offers warm daylight, botanical greenery, and ergonomic seating for morning reading or remote sessions.

spatialZones.name: 03. Glass-Walled Roastery
spatialZones.signatureEquipment: Convection Drum Roaster & Sample Cupping Lab
spatialZones.description: Behind steel-framed acoustic glass, green coffee burlap sacks from Ethiopia, Colombia, and Kenya are roasted twice weekly with live thermal profiling.

spatialZones.name: 04. Sunlit Garden Courtyard
spatialZones.signatureEquipment: Heated Cedar Pergola & Steel Bi-Fold Doors
spatialZones.description: Steel bi-fold doors open onto a sheltered courtyard lined with Pacific Northwest ferns, Japanese maples, and bistro seating for unhurried afternoons.

menuItems.name: Stoneware Cortado
menuItems.description: Double ristretto pulled at 9 bars and balanced with equal parts textured whole or oat milk in a hand-thrown stoneware cup.

menuItems.name: Ethiopia Guji V60
menuItems.description: Hand-poured to order through a ribbed ceramic cone using remineralized water for floral clarity and tea-like sweetness.

menuItems.name: Espresso & Filter Flight
menuItems.description: One lot prepared two ways—a bright straight espresso paired with a chilled sparkling water palate cleanser and 4oz filter pour.

menuItems.name: Huila Reserve Kalita
menuItems.description: Flat-bottom ceramic extraction emphasizing syrupy mouthfeel, stone fruit sweetness, and a lingering chocolate finish.

menuItems.name: Ethiopia Guji · 250g Bag
menuItems.description: Small-batch whole bean coffee roasted in our Pearl District glass roastery; valve-sealed within two hours of cooling.

menuItems.name: Laminated Cardamom Knot
menuItems.description: Twenty-seven-layer sourdough brioche folded with cultured Normandy butter and freshly mortar-crushed green cardamom pods.
